outcome: suppressors of cytokine signaling (SOCS1, SOCS2, SOCS3)
proinflammatory cytokines (IFN-gamma, IL1-beta, IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, TNF-alpha)
cohort: Placentas from women who conceived via assisted reproductive technologies (ART) and non-ART controls (n=14 each) were evaluated, matched for maternal and gestational age, delivery method, pregnancy weight gain, and body mass index.
finding: ART was associated with significantly lower SOCS3 and dysregulated cytokine signaling in human placentas, with altered associations between SOCS and cytokines observed in ART, advanced maternal age, and preterm birth.
gest_age: Both term and preterm gestations were included and matched for gestational age between ART and non-ART groups.
